name: Being A Pilgrim
overview: Scripture presents the believer's life as a pilgrimage, a journey marked by obedience to God's call and a recognition that our true citizenship is not of this world. From God's command to Abram to leave his homeland (Genesis 12:1) to Jacob's reflection on his life as a pilgrimage (Genesis 47:9), the Christian walk involves trusting God's guidance beyond earthly ties. Jesus affirms that His kingdom is not of this world (John 18:36), reminding believers that their hope rests in the eternal life granted through faith in Him (John 3:16), even as the kingdom of God is unseen and spiritual in nature (Luke 17:20).
